title: 1e FRPG: OA Lite
description: An optional add-on for 1e FRPG, based on OA (TSR, 1985), for any campaign: the OA races and classes on the character sheet, martial arts, OA proficiencies, shukenja and wu jen spells, OA weapons, armor and equipment priced in standard coins, magic items and monsters, with the rules restated in plain words. Leaves out the Eastern Lands setting, family, honor and society rules, OA's own money and the running-the-game chapters. Adds an OA tab and compendia. Don't run it with the full OA module. Turn it on or off in Manage Modules.

conflicts.reason: Both modules add the same OA races and classes; use one or the other.
